Name: Young Marlon Sprites
Author: danohol
Description:
This is a custom sprite sheet designed to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15229]Young Marlon Portraits[/url] by LT4823 and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] by WerewolfMaster.
You must have them installed for these sprites to work.
This file [b]does not include the abovementioned mods.[/b][b]
[/b]
This mod is a single image named 'Marlon.png', containing the new sprites. Simply download it and copy the image to Mods/[CP] Make Marlon Real/assets/Sprites. It will prompt you to replace the existing image, press yes. This will replace the old sprite sheet with the new one, and boom,  you're done! Enjoy your handsome, revamped Marlon~
